output.summary: Short-trunked or trunkless yucca native to deserts of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has blue-green leaves and white-to-cream spring flowers tinged purple, followed by banana-shaped fruit eaten raw or cooked; young flower stalks are cooked after their tough rind is removed.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten raw or cooked and was historically dried for winter; young flower stalks are cooked after peeling, and flowers are also eaten.
